sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with a win in their most recent outing and five wins from their last six matches. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are struggling badly, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be strong favourites to extend their dominant position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a match that could see them maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in an interesting mid-table contest, with both sides occupying upper-half positions. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) in a fixture where the higher-ranked side will be favoured. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table and struggling sides; Shawbury are winless in their last five matches. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a tight affair at the lower end of the division, with Market Drayton currently four places above. Crewe host Allscott Heath, another fixture involving sides in the lower half. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the bottom, visit Telford Town (18th) in what shapes as a tight contest between two struggling clubs. Finally, Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town; Widnes are pointless after 7 games and sit at the very foot of the table, making this a potential opportunity for Brereton to climb the standings.
